name: footer_empty
reason: Wrong palette in src/widgets/footer-component.tsx: FOOTER_BACKGROUND is hardcoded to `#212B32`, but Python Textual's footer bar bg is `#242f38` (verified in visual-tests/snapshots/python/footer_empty.json — every cell on the bar row has background `#242f38`). xterm in Docker faithfully renders both colors; there is no truecolor rendering bug. Fix: change the constant. The earlier diagnosis (`xterm renders #212B32 as pure black`, with candidates around Ink's whitespace BG emission / xterm-direct terminfo / scroll-erase) was symptom-blaming — none of those candidates were verified, and consulting the Python baseline JSON immediately disproves them.

name: footer_with_bindings
reason:
Three independent palette/format gaps in src/widgets/footer-component.tsx and src/framework/app-framework.ts (verified against visual-tests/snapshots/python/footer_with_bindings.json):
  1. Bar background: JS `FOOTER_BACKGROUND = '#212B32'` vs Python `#242f38` (same as footer_empty).
  2. Chip key color: JS `FOOTER_KEY_COLOR = '#fea62b'` vs Python `#ffa62b` (typo: `fe` should be `ff`).
  3. Palette separator (`▏`) color: JS uses default fg `#e0e0e0` vs Python's dimmer `#495259`.
  4. Key formatting: JS `getKeyDisplay` emits `ctrl+r` vs Python's caret form `^r` — locatable in src/framework/app-framework.ts.
No truecolor/xterm rendering bug exists; the previous diagnosis was symptom-blaming.

name: input_empty
reason: Root cause is widget-layer (not symptom-blamed): src/widgets/input-component.tsx has no `defaultCss` and no placeholder rendering. JS Input renders nothing when `value` is empty — even with `placeholder` set — because `placeholder` is not part of `InputProps` and the displayValue path (line ~239) only consults `modelRef.current.value`. Python's Input is full-width with `border: tall` (top/bottom half-block bars) over `$boost` background; JS emits bare text only. Fix: add Input default CSS (background, border, padding, height, width 100%) and wire `placeholder` through props/model/render.

name: input_filled
reason: Root cause is widget-layer: src/widgets/input-component.tsx has no `defaultCss`, so Python's full-width slate-bg box with top/bottom half-block border (`border: tall`) plus 1-cell horizontal padding is missing. JS just renders the value text inline. Fix: define DEFAULT_CSS for Input (background, border, padding, height, width:100%) the same way Footer does.

name: input_invalid
reason: Two gaps: (a) the same missing default CSS as input_filled (no border/bg/padding); (b) no styling rule for `Input.-invalid` is registered, so even though src/widgets/input-component.tsx already toggles the `-invalid` class on validation failure (syncValidationClasses), there is nothing to render against it. Python's Textual ships `border: tall $error` on `:invalid`. Fix: add the default CSS and an Input.-invalid rule (red border).

name: input_password
reason: Wrong obfuscation character: src/widgets/input-component.tsx line ~240 uses `*` (`'*'.repeat(...)`); Python uses `•` (U+2022 BULLET). Plus the same missing default CSS as input_filled. Fix: change the character constant and add Input default CSS.

name: input_focused
reason: Tab now routes to Input via the Ink key bridge, but the Input widget has no :focus visual styling, so the screen state is unchanged after focus and the xterm watchdog still times out. Distinct from the previous diagnosis (which blamed the bridge): Input rendering needs a focus indicator. Tracked under .14.

name: input_placeholder_only
reason: Root cause is widget-layer: src/widgets/input-component.tsx does not accept a `placeholder` prop (not part of InputProps) and the render path only outputs `modelRef.current.value`. With value empty, nothing is drawn. Fix: add `placeholder` to InputProps, store on the model, and render the dim placeholder text when `value.length === 0` (Python uses `text-style: dim`). Also covers the same missing default CSS as input_filled.
